svg.title: The Open Seal
svg.desc: A round seal with a gate. A gold wall stands open at the bottom, and light from a hearth at the centre leaves through the opening between two posts. Around the wall runs a ring of 57 places. Eight of them carry half a bead on a stem. Outside, a second ring carries the other eight halves, turned. Inside the wall, threads join every pair of the eight, no two the same length, and two uneven triangles stand among them. The outer ring steps round one place a beat. At every step exactly one outer half lands on an inner half and makes a whole bead; once a turn all eight close together.
